Hi Riley,

Thank you for reporting the Webhook Retry customer incident. To help us investigate and resolve this as quickly as possible, could you please provide the following diagnostics:

1. Error logs or stack traces from the time of the incident
2. Timestamp(s) of when the failures occurred
3. Affected webhook endpoint URLs
4. HTTP response codes received during failed retry attempts
5. Number of retries attempted and the retry interval configuration
6. Any recent changes to your environment (deployments, config changes, etc.)

Please share these at your earliest convenience so we can move forward with the investigation.

Best regards
